api:
<EyeDiagram data={samples} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.volts} period={1.} offset={0.5} />
PropTypeDefault
datasamples in time orderrequired
xFn(&T) -> f64: timerequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
periodf64: one unit interval, in the units of xrequired
offsetf64: time that lands on the left edge0.
spansusize: unit intervals shown2
thresholdf64: the level crossings are counted athalfway between the lowest and highest value
jitterbool: show the crossing histogram belowtrue
binsusize: histogram bins across the window60
trace_opacityf320.25
colorcolour of the tracesthe first series colour
x_axis, y_axisAxisConfig; x is always the window
classTailwind classes ("h-64")

The signal is cut every spans × period and the pieces are drawn on top of each other, joined across each cut so traces stay continuous. Faint traces build up into a density picture. The strip below counts where the signal crosses threshold inside the window: its width is the timing jitter. Built on <XYChart> and <Trend>, so Ctrl+scroll zooms both.

examples.title: Clean NRZ
examples.description: 400 random bits folded on two unit intervals; the strip below counts threshold crossings.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn clean() {
    let data = use_signal(nrz(1, 0.3, 0.01, 0.2));
    rsx! { <EyeDiagram data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.volts} period={1.} offset={0.5} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Labelled units
examples.description: Axis labels in ns and V.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn nanoseconds() {
    let data = use_signal(
        nrz(10, 0.3, 0.015, 0.3)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|sample| Sample {
                time: sample.time * 0.8,
                volts: sample.volts * 0.8 - 0.4,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <EyeDiagram data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.volts} period={0.8} offset={0.4} x_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("ns")} y_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("V")} class="h-96" /> }
}
